news.title: RASHU CUP GROUPS REVEALED — EUPHEX DRAWN WITH NOVA
news.excerpt: Defending champions open against Nova Sentinels on Sep 28. Group of controlled chaos.
body: Euphex learned their Rashu Cup group-stage fate this morning — and the draw did nobody any favors.
Euphex open against Nova Sentinels on September 28 at Amman Arena, before facing Halcyon Five in a rematch of last year's semifinal.
“We don't dodge anyone,” said shotcaller Nawrrr. “Groups are for warming up.”

news.title: EUPHEX LOCKS THREE FOR 2026
news.excerpt: Nawrrr, Zinzinnextdoor, xxGokgokxx. One standard. One goal.
body: The organization confirmed its main three for the 2026 season — a Roam, a Gold laner, and a Mid laner with leaderboard pedigree.
Nawrrr (two-time Maldives No.1 Minotaur), Zinzinnextdoor (No.1 Lesley and Layla), and xxGokgokxx (seven leaderboard finishes) form the core.
Aurex completes the picture: two squads, one standard.

news.title: AUREX ANNOUNCED AS SECOND SQUAD
news.excerpt: Kairo, Sable, and the second squad step onto the main stage.
body: The organization is now two squads strong: Euphex and Aurex.
Aurex — Kairo, Sable, Drift, Onyx, and Wisp — takes over the open-circuit and challenger slots.
“They didn't come to participate,” said the head coach. “They came to take games.”

news.title: EUPHEX LIFTS MIDNIGHT INVITATIONAL 3–1
news.excerpt: Nawrrr goes supernova in the grand final against Apex Falcons.
body: Four games. One statement. Euphex are Midnight Invitational champions.
Zinzinnextdoor's takeover in Game 3 set the tone; Nawrrr's engages closed the door in Game 4.
The trophy starts a new cabinet. The standard holds.

news.title: AUREX'S REVENGE RUN — SEMIFINAL REMATCH SET
news.excerpt: Iron Lynx Academy stand between Aurex and another final.
body: Aurex swept the semifinal qualifier 2–0 and booked the rematch everyone wanted.
Kairo's Ling was untouchable. Sable didn't die once across the series.

news.title: OPEN TRIALS RECAP — HOW AUREX WAS BUILT
news.excerpt: Inside the two-week gauntlet that forged the second squad.
body: Custom lobbies at midnight. VOD reviews at dawn. Forty hopefuls cut to five.
The trials prioritized communication over mechanics — and it showed.
Full documentary drops on the Media page next week.

timeline.title: ORGANIZATION FOUNDED
timeline.text: Five friends, one laptop per player, and a borrowed scrim room.

timeline.title: FIRST TOURNAMENT
timeline.text: Euphex debuts. Nobody knows the name. Everybody remembers the Fanny.

timeline.title: TWO SQUADS
timeline.text: Aurex joins as second squad — one standard, two bites.
